question: How do I unsubscribe from a Value Added Service (VAS) I didn't request?
answer: Go to My Subscriptions in the app to view all active VAS (caller tunes, content packs, insurance add-ons, etc.) and deactivate any you did not authorise. Unauthorised VAS activation can also be reported via Complaints for a refund review, per TRAI's consent-based subscription rules.
